data.subject: Local Ledger weekly issue and pilot
data.body:
Hi,

STILWELL VALUE LLC's most recent 13F for June 30, 2026, shows positions in CPBI and SFBC.

On September 23, 2026, CPBI disclosed a director or officer change in an 8-K Item 5.02 filing (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1979332/000094337426000419/cpbi-20260922.htm).

I can send the free weekly issue and outline a four-week fund pilot. Reply "no" and I won't follow up.
